passages.text: Financial Condition and Results of Operations The MD&A is intended to provide a narrative description of the Company’s business from management’s perspective, which includes an overview of Ovintiv’s consolidated 2025 results and year-over-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024 results. This MD&A should be read in conjunction with the audited Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying notes for the year ended December 31, 2025 (“Consolidated Financial Statements”), which are included in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Discussion and analysis of 2023 results and year-over-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 results that are not included in this Form 10-K, can be found in Item 7 of the 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K. Common industry terms and abbreviations are used throughout this MD&A and are defined in the Definitions, Conversions and Conventions sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This MD&A includes the following sections: • Executive Overview • Results of Operations • Liquidity and Capital Resources • Accounting Policies and Estimates • Non-GAAP Measures Execu tive Overview Strategy Ovintiv aims to be a leading North American energy producer and is focused on developing its high-quality multi-basin portfolio of oil and natural gas producing plays as part of its strategy outlined in Items 1 and 2 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Ovintiv is committed to delivering quality returns from its capital investment, generating significant cash flows and providing durable cash returns to its shareholders through the commodity price cycle. The Company aims to achieve its strategic priorities through execution excellence, disciplined capital allocation, and commercial acumen and risk management. In addition, the Company is dedicated to driving progress in the area of sustainability, aligning with its commitment to corporate responsibility. In support of the Company’s commitment to enhancing shareholder value, Ovintiv utilizes its shareholder return framework to provide competitive returns to shareholders while strengthening its balance sheet. Ovintiv continually monitors and evaluates changing market conditions to maximize cash flows, mitigate risks and renew its premium well inventory. The Company’s high-quality assets, located in the United States and Canada, form a multi-basin, multi-product portfolio which enables flexible and efficient investment of capital that supports the Company’s strategy. Ovintiv seeks to deliver results in a socially and environmentally responsible manner. Best practices are deployed across its assets, allowing the Company to capitalize on operational efficiencies and decrease emissions intensity. The Company’s sustainability reporting, which outlines its key metrics, targets and relative progress achieved, can be found in the Company Outlook section of this MD&A and on the Company’s sustainability website. Underpinning Ovintiv’s strategy are core values of one, agile, innovative and driven, which guide the organization to be collaborative, responsive, flexible and determined. credit_strengths.text: Ovintiv's multi-basin oil and gas portfolio generates substantial operating cash flow that comfortably funds capital spending, leaving meaningful free cash flow after reinvestment to support debt reduction and shareholder returns through the commodity cycle.

Leverage sits modestly above the sector median but remains within the minimal risk tier, with net debt to EBITDA net of cash and short-term investments close to the tier threshold, indicating limited cushion before a downgrade in the indicative profile.

key_risks.text: Operating income has declined for consecutive years as revenue softened, compressing the operating margin below the sector median; continued commodity price weakness would erode EBITDA and thin the already narrow leverage headroom in the indicative profile.

The maturity profile concentrates refinancing needs in the near term, with a sizable tranche due within twelve months against a thin unrestricted cash balance, so the company depends on refinancing access and ongoing cash generation to meet maturities.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is well below the sector median, reflecting a meaningful interest burden relative to operating income; coverage remains adequate but offers limited absorption of further earnings decline, and capitalised interest is excluded from the reported expense.

Free cash flow to debt is broadly in line with the sector median and operating cash flow covers debt service comfortably, though the current ratio below one signals reliance on revolving liquidity rather than balance-sheet cash.

overall_credit_view.text: Analyst judgement: the credit profile is solid but not exceptional, with leverage slightly above the sector median and coverage materially weaker, offset by resilient cash generation and a multi-basin asset base that supports through-cycle investment flexibility.

Shareholder distributions and buybacks absorb a large share of free cash flow, limiting deleveraging capacity; we view the company as reliant on sustained commodity prices and refinancing access to preserve its minimal-tier profile.

credit_strengths.text: Ovintiv 的多盆地油氣資產組合產生可觀的營運現金流，足以輕鬆支應資本支出，並在再投資後留下有意義的自由現金流，以支持跨商品週期的減債及股東回報。
槓桿略高於行業中位數，但仍處於最低風險級別之內，扣除現金及短期投資後的淨債務對 EBITDA 比率接近該級別門檻，顯示在指示性評級中下調前緩衝有限。

key_risks.text: 隨著收入轉弱，營運收入已連續數年下降，令營運利潤率壓縮至低於行業中位數；商品價格持續疲弱將侵蝕 EBITDA，並進一步收窄指示性評級中本已狹窄的槓桿緩衝。
到期結構將再融資需求集中於短期，十二個月內有一筆規模可觀的批次到期，而可動用現金結餘偏薄，因此公司依賴再融資渠道及持續現金產生能力以應付到期債務。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率遠低於行業中位數，反映相對於營運收入的重大利息負擔；覆蓋率仍屬足夠，但吸納盈利進一步下滑的能力有限，且已資本化利息未計入所報告的費用。
自由現金流對債務比率大致與行業中位數一致，營運現金流可輕鬆覆蓋債務償付，惟流動比率低於一，顯示依賴循環流動性而非資產負債表現金。

overall_credit_view.text: 分析師判斷：信貸狀況穩健但並非卓越，槓桿略高於行業中位數且覆蓋率明顯較弱，惟由具韌性的現金產生能力及多盆地資產基礎所抵銷，支持跨週期的投資靈活性。
股東分派及回購佔用大部分自由現金流，限制減債能力；我們認為公司依賴持續的商品價格及再融資渠道以維持其最低級別的信貸狀況。
